title: Creature stat-block entry boundaries: restore swallowed Wererat Hand Crossbow and gate source-counted attack headers
description:
SCOPE (registry row wererat-crossbow, alias opus:F-30; plan B2 + D2 "swallowed Wererat action").
Class: a creature stat-block ENTRY (action/reaction/legendary/trait/variant) whose text swallows a following printed entry header, so a whole attack is lost as its own entry.

Pack evidence (c53ba040): creature:wererat actions "Shortsword (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)" text contains "... piercing damage. Hand Crossbow (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only). Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 30/120 ft. ..." — 2 attack headers in one entry. A pack scan for (>1 "(Melee|Ranged) (Weapon|Spell) Attack:" per entry) OR (". <Title>[ (qual)]. Melee|Ranged") finds exactly this one live instance (creature:giant-rat variant "Diseased Giant Rats" quotes "Bite" in prose - verify it is a prose reference, not a swallowed header).

Root cause: find in parseCreatures.ts / parseStatBlocks.ts entry segmentation - why the "Hand Crossbow (…)." header was not recognized as an entry start (likely the parenthetical qualifier / page-or-column break layout). Fix the segmenter, not the record.

Required invariant: every printed attack header in a creature stat block is its own entry. Denominator is SOURCE-derived: count "(Melee|Ranged|Melee or Ranged) (Weapon|Spell) Attack:" occurrences in each creature's extracted source text vs the count of parsed attack entries; exact equality per creature (with a reviewed, source-cited exception list only if the source itself embeds an attack in another entry's prose).

Regression: parser test on the Wererat source slice (Hand Crossbow is its own action with ranged attack +4, 30/120, 1d6+2 piercing); corpus predicate test over the committed pack using the source-derived count. Regenerate the pack (npm run build:dnd5e-srd-pack or equivalent) and commit generated outputs; follow docs/importer-fix-protocol.md.
notes:
PR #571 (head 5751d799). Root cause: ENTRY_LABEL_RE required same-line body; label-only lead-ins swallowed. Source scan (creature pages) found 2 members: Wererat Hand Crossbow p.328 and Chain Devil Animate Chains p.275 (not in audit). Fixed in parseCreatures.ts; regenerated pack changes exactly those two; committed-pack predicate (≤1 attack lead-in, no embedded usage/form-qualified lead-in per entry) + parser tests incl. negatives. verify:worktree green 5389/3 skipped. Stays in_progress until merge.
Review F1 (source-derived denominator) fixed at a6ecc402: importer gate creatureAttackLeadIns.ts, per-creature source slice count vs entries opening with attack lead-in; Giant Rat p.378 reviewed exception; negative proof fails on wererat 3 vs 2. Re-review requested.
close_reason: PR #571 merged (c492c918): label-only creature lead-ins + source-derived attack lead-in gate
